outputs.explanation: Panel a contains a schematic (cropping icon) and micrographs illustrating image cropping/rotation; no plot with averaged data is present.
Panel b shows a schematic and micrographs illustrating image spacing; no plot with averaged data is present.
Panel c shows a schematic and micrographs (with inset) illustrating magnification/inset presentation; no plot with averaged data is present.
Panel d shows a min/max slider schematic and micrographs illustrating brightness/contrast adjustment; no plot with averaged data is present.
Panel e shows schematic 'Aa' background examples and micrographs illustrating channel annotation visibility; no plot with averaged data is present.
Panel f shows a schematic (color overlap diagram) and micrographs illustrating grayscale channel display; no plot with averaged data is present.
Panel g shows schematic calibration scale diagrams and micrographs with intensity/pseudocolor scales; these are calibration legends, not plots of averaged data requiring individual points.
